syntheses.title: Contradiction Between Limitations of Pure Imitation Learning and Successful End-to-End Neural Network Driving
syntheses.body: Paper A presents findings that pure imitation learning has limitations in driving performance, even with large datasets and mid-level input/output representations (claims 09081b52-e1ad-5843-9bbc-8565cf5aea59, 639f88c8-001d-587a-bae9-390fb3c89dcf). In contrast, Paper B reports that an end-to-end trained neural network (ALVINN) successfully steered a car on public roads (claim 443f6210-6468-59f8-8167-b719d39fc8fd). This represents a contradiction in the effectiveness of pure imitation learning approaches for driving tasks.
